edits.before: Q-bloom the pair — bot's formations eat the triple pop beautifully.
edits.after: Q Blooming Burst pokes Braum and his ADC freely — he has no ranged answer at 1.

edits.before: Clone games begin: the lane's information war opens in your favor.
edits.after: The double-Q zone punishes Braum before his Q Winter's Bite slow is a real threat.

edits.before: E threats live: the root into bloom chunks; pick one window per wave.
edits.after: Your ranged harass keeps beating his short-range kit through level 3.

edits.before: Pop Blossom online — the disguise plus R turns brush control into ambush law.
edits.after: Pop Blossom's AoE stun cuts through his peel — his W shield and passive don't stop hard CC.

edits.before: - Braum Unbreakable: matchup-defining — The shield wall eats your poke and engage projectiles — wait it out. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your W Shapesplitter answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Q Winter's Bite: 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s, slows and stacks Concussive Blows — dodge it and he cannot stun you. - E Unbreakable: 16/14/12/10/8s, blocks poke from one direction — walk around it. - R Glacial Fissure: 130/115/100s.

edits.before: E the cover-line, Q the rooted pile, auto the passive — the lane's longest pick paid in pairs.
edits.after: Once his E Unbreakable is down, step up: E-root the engage, then Q-auto while his shield is on cooldown.

edits.before: Q-poking with the E banked forever — the root is the threat; the bloom is just the receipt.
edits.after: Poking with Q while your E sits banked wastes the root — it is what punishes his committed chain.

edits.before: E the cover-line, Q the rooted pile, auto the passive — the lane's longest pick paid in pairs.
edits.after: Poke freely while his E Unbreakable is down; once it is up, wait it out before you commit your root.

edits.before: Q-poking with the E banked forever — the root is the threat; the bloom is just the receipt.
edits.after: Walking into his E block to keep Q-poking — he's absorbing it for free while your root sits unused.

edits.before: Braum wins by landing Unbreakable, denying your pattern, and converting a single landed engage into your carry’s bad week.
edits.after: Braum wins by timing E Unbreakable to block your poke, then landing his passive stun into a W-peeled all-in.
